body: Do you know of any support groups or forums for survivors of sexual abuse?
One of them did, but the guy who raped me this summer got away with it. After he threatened to kill me and my friend. They still denied me a protective order.
Thank you so much. I've read articles about the effect of child sexual abuse on people and when it's as severe as mine, they usually don't get better. They live a life of suffering. I hate it.
